edges.notes: NetBSD libc implements C and POSIX interfaces for hosted C on NetBSD triplets.
NetBSD libc and the dynamic linker participate in ELF dynamic linking on supported architectures.
GCC in NetBSD base and pkgsrc toolchains commonly links against NetBSD libc.
GNU ld links against libc in typical NetBSD ELF flows.
Clang/LLVM may be used in pkgsrc and link against libc where configured.
